messages.subject: D-RUG This Thursday
parts:
Hi D-RUGgies! 

We will be meeting this Thursday (12/4) from 10-noon virtually and in person in the DataLab classroom (Library 360). This is a group working session so come with your questions for our expeRts, or just bring your laptop and get in some distraction free R-coding time. Additionally, if there are topics you would like to see someone do a deeper dive on, let us know!

D-RUG: 10am-noon, DataLab Classroom, Library 360, and zoom https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09

Please consider posting your questions to our Discourse site in advance of attending D-RUG virtually. This helps us do a better job of answering your questions, and also keep a log of the types of questions we see frequently.

See you then,

Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators
